title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: modernised Gallery view prioritises video on stage
summary: Hold: the licensing requirement omits Microsoft's explicit allowance for valid legacy Teams Rooms licences, which could lead administrators to replace licences unnecessarily. The rollout, default behaviour and portal route are supported; the abbreviated route and conflicting cloud documentation need minor clarification.
